name: Eden
description: The garden the LORD God planted eastward, where He put the man He had formed. Adam and Eve were driven out of it after they ate of the tree.

name: Ararat
description: The mountains where the ark rested in the seventh month, as the waters of the flood abated.

name: Babel
description: The city and tower built in the land of Shinar, whose builders meant to reach unto heaven. It is called Babel because there the LORD confounded the language of all the earth.

name: Ur
description: The city of the Chaldees that Terah left with Abram, and out of which the LORD brought Abram.

name: Haran
description: The city where Terah settled and died, from which Abram departed at seventy and five years old, and to which Jacob fled from Esau.

name: Canaan
description: The land the LORD promised to Abraham and to his seed for an everlasting possession, and which Israel came to possess under Joshua.

name: Shechem
description: The first place in Canaan where Abram pitched, where Jacob later bought a parcel of a field, and where Joshua gathered the tribes and made a covenant.

name: Bethel
description: The place where Jacob dreamed of the ladder and called the name of it Bethel, saying, This is none other but the house of God. Jeroboam later set a golden calf there.

name: Hebron
description: Where Abram dwelt by the oaks of Mamre and buried Sarah, and where David reigned over Judah seven years and six months before he took Jerusalem.

name: Sodom
description: The city of the plain toward which Lot pitched his tent, whose men were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly, and which the LORD overthrew with brimstone and fire.

name: Gomorrah
description: The city overthrown with Sodom when the LORD rained brimstone and fire out of heaven. Scripture holds both up ever after as a warning.

name: Beersheba
description: The well and place of oath in the south, named when Abraham and Abimelech sware there. "From Dan even to Beersheba" came to mean the whole land.

name: Moriah
description: The land whose mountain God named when He told Abraham to offer Isaac there; Solomon afterward built the house of the LORD in mount Moriah.

name: Egypt
description: The land Abram went down to in famine, where Joseph rose to rule, where Israel was in bondage four hundred and thirty years, and out of which the LORD brought them with a mighty hand.

name: Goshen
description: The best of the land of Egypt, given to Jacob's house at Joseph's word; Israel dwelt there, and the plagues did not touch it.

name: Peniel
description: The place Jacob named after wrestling until the breaking of the day, saying, I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

name: Jabbok
description: The ford Jacob passed over the night he sent his household ahead and was left alone; it was afterward a border in the land.

name: Midian
description: The land Moses fled to from Pharaoh, where he married Zipporah and kept the flock of Jethro before the LORD called him.

name: Red Sea
description: The sea the LORD divided so Israel went through on dry ground, and in which Pharaoh's host was drowned.

name: Marah
description: The first water Israel found after the sea, and it was bitter; the LORD showed Moses a tree, and the waters were made sweet.

name: Elim
description: The camp beyond Marah where there were twelve wells of water and threescore and ten palm trees.

name: Rephidim
description: The camp where there was no water and the LORD gave it out of the rock in Horeb, and where Amalek came and fought with Israel.

name: Mount Sinai
description: The mount the LORD descended upon in fire, where He spake the ten commandments and gave Moses the two tables of testimony written with the finger of God.

name: Horeb
description: The mountain of God where the LORD appeared to Moses in the burning bush, and where Elijah afterward heard the still small voice.

name: Kadeshbarnea
description: The place in the wilderness from which the twelve spies were sent into Canaan, and where Israel refused to go up and was turned back.

name: Mount Nebo
description: The mountain over against Jericho from whose top the LORD shewed Moses all the land, and where Moses died.

name: Moab
description: The land east of Jordan where Israel camped before crossing over, where Balak hired Balaam, and from which Ruth came.

name: Edom
description: The land of Esau's descendants, south of the Dead Sea, which refused Israel passage in the wilderness and against which the prophets spoke.

name: Gilead
description: The hill country east of Jordan where Laban overtook Jacob, given to Reuben, Gad and half Manasseh, and famous for its balm.

name: Jordan
description: The river Israel crossed on dry ground into the promised land, where Naaman washed seven times, and where John baptized and the Lord Jesus was baptized.

name: Jericho
description: The walled city Israel first took in Canaan, whose walls fell down flat after they compassed it seven days; Rahab and her house were saved alive.

name: Ai
description: The city Israel could not take while Achan's sin was in the camp, and which was taken afterward by ambush.

name: Gilgal
description: Israel's first camp west of Jordan, where the twelve stones were set up, where they were circumcised and kept the passover, and where Saul was made king.

name: Mount Ebal
description: The mount of cursing, where Joshua built an altar and wrote upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses.

name: Mount Gerizim
description: The mount of blessing over against Ebal, and where Jotham stood and cried his parable to the men of Shechem.

name: Hazor
description: The head of the northern kingdoms, which Joshua took and burnt with fire; Jabin king of Hazor later oppressed Israel in the days of Deborah.

name: Shiloh
description: Where the tabernacle of the congregation was set up and the land divided by lot, and where Samuel ministered before Eli.

name: Dan
description: The northernmost city of Israel, named by the Danites after they took Laish; Jeroboam set the second golden calf there.

name: Gaza
description: The Philistine city where Samson carried away the gates and where he was bound and afterward pulled down the house of Dagon.

name: Ashdod
description: The Philistine city where the captured ark was set in the house of Dagon, and where Dagon fell before it.

name: Gath
description: The Philistine city Goliath came out of, and to which David fled from Saul and feigned madness before Achish.

name: Mizpah
description: The place of gathering: where Jacob and Laban heaped stones, where Israel assembled as one man, and where Samuel judged and Saul was chosen king.

name: Ramah
description: Samuel's city, where he judged Israel, anointed kings and was buried; Jeremiah heard a voice of weeping there.

name: Gibeah
description: The city of Saul, where he dwelt after he was made king, and the place of the outrage that brought all Israel against Benjamin.

name: Valley of Elah
description: Where Israel and the Philistines set the battle in array and David slew Goliath with a sling and a stone.

name: Endor
description: Where Saul, on the eve of his last battle, sought out a woman that had a familiar spirit.

name: Mount Gilboa
description: Where the Philistines fought against Israel, and where Saul and his sons fell.

name: Jerusalem
description: The stronghold David took from the Jebusites and made the city of David; the place of Solomon's temple, of the Lord's crucifixion and resurrection, and of Pentecost.

name: Zion
description: The stronghold David took, called the city of David; Scripture uses the name for the mountain of the LORD's house and for His people.

name: Tyre
description: The city of Hiram, who sent David and Solomon cedar and workmen; the prophets afterward spoke against her pride, and the Lord named her in reproving Chorazin.

name: Sidon
description: The coastal city near Tyre; Zarephath belonged to it, and the Lord went into its borders and healed the daughter of a Syrophenician woman.

name: Mount Carmel
description: Where Elijah called all Israel together and the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice before the prophets of Baal.

name: Zarephath
description: The city of Zidon where Elijah was sustained by a widow whose barrel of meal did not waste, and whose son was raised to life.

name: Jezreel
description: Where Ahab had his palace and Naboth his vineyard, and where Jezebel was thrown down from the window.

name: Samaria
description: The hill Omri bought and built on, the capital of the ten tribes until Assyria carried them away; in the Gospels and Acts, the region between Judaea and Galilee.

name: Assyria
description: The empire the LORD used as the rod of His anger, which carried Israel away out of their own land and besieged Jerusalem in Hezekiah's day.

name: Nineveh
description: The great city of Assyria that Jonah was sent to, which repented at his preaching; Nahum afterward pronounced its burden.

name: Babylon
description: The kingdom that burnt the temple and carried Judah captive for seventy years, and whose name Revelation gives to the great harlot city.

name: Shushan
description: The palace of the Persian kings where Esther was made queen, where Nehemiah served the king, and where Daniel saw a vision.

name: Bethlehem
description: The city of David, where Ruth gleaned, where Samuel anointed David, and where Micah said the Ruler in Israel should come forth; there Jesus Christ was born.

name: Nazareth
description: The city of Galilee where Joseph and Mary dwelt and where Jesus was brought up; He read Isaiah in its synagogue and was cast out of the city.

name: Capernaum
description: The city on the sea coast where Jesus dwelt after leaving Nazareth; He taught in its synagogue and did many mighty works there.

name: Sea of Galilee
description: The sea where Jesus called fishermen to follow Him, stilled the storm, walked on the water, and appeared to the disciples after He was risen.

name: Bethsaida
description: The city of Andrew and Peter, where the Lord healed a blind man by leading him out of the town, and which He reproved for not repenting.

name: Cana
description: The village of Galilee where Jesus turned the water into wine, the beginning of miracles, and where He healed the nobleman's son by a word.

name: Caesarea Philippi
description: The coasts where Jesus asked, Whom say ye that I am, and Peter answered, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

name: Sychar
description: The city of Samaria near Jacob's well, where Jesus spoke to the woman of Samaria and many of the Samaritans believed.

name: Bethany
description: The town of Mary, Martha and Lazarus, where the Lord raised Lazarus and was anointed, and out as far as which He led the disciples before He was taken up.

name: Mount of Olives
description: The mount east of Jerusalem from which the Lord rode into the city, where He taught of His coming, and from which He ascended.

name: Gethsemane
description: The place where Jesus prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me, and where Judas betrayed Him.

name: Golgotha
description: The place of a skull where they crucified the Lord Jesus, and two others with Him, on either side one.

name: Emmaus
description: The village about threescore furlongs from Jerusalem toward which two disciples walked when the risen Lord joined them and opened the scriptures.

name: Joppa
description: The sea port Jonah went down to in fleeing to Tarshish, where Peter raised Tabitha and saw the vision of the sheet let down from heaven.

name: Caesarea
description: The coastal city where Cornelius sent for Peter and the Gentiles received the Holy Ghost, and where Paul was kept and heard by Felix, Festus and Agrippa.

name: Damascus
description: The city Saul was journeying to with letters against the disciples when the light shined about him; there Ananias was sent to him and he first preached Christ.

name: Tarsus
description: Paul's own city in Cilicia; he called it no mean city, and the brethren sent him there for safety after his conversion.

name: Antioch
description: The church that first sent Barnabas and Saul out to the Gentiles, and where the disciples were called Christians first.

name: Cyprus
description: The island Barnabas came from and the first stop of the journey he and Saul were sent on from Antioch.

name: Iconium
description: The city where Paul and Barnabas spake so that a great multitude believed, and out of which they were driven; Paul later reminded Timothy of his sufferings there.

name: Lystra
description: Where a man impotent in his feet was healed and the people would have done sacrifice to Paul and Barnabas, and where Paul was stoned; Timothy was from there.

name: Troas
description: Where Paul saw the vision of a man of Macedonia praying him to come over and help them, and where Eutychus fell from the third loft and was taken up alive.

name: Philippi
description: The chief city of that part of Macedonia, where Lydia's heart was opened, where Paul and Silas sang at midnight in the prison, and to which Paul wrote an epistle.

name: Thessalonica
description: Where Paul reasoned three sabbath days out of the scriptures and a church was gathered, to which he wrote two epistles.

name: Berea
description: Whose hearers were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind and searched the scriptures daily.

name: Athens
description: The city wholly given to idolatry where Paul's spirit was stirred in him, and where he preached the Unknown God on Mars' hill.

name: Corinth
description: Where Paul stayed a year and six months teaching the word of God, having been told, I have much people in this city; he wrote it two epistles.

name: Ephesus
description: Where Paul taught two years so that all Asia heard the word, where the silversmiths raised an uproar for Diana, and the first of the seven churches of Revelation.

name: Colosse
description: The city of the saints and faithful brethren in Christ to whom Paul wrote of the preeminence of the Son.

name: Galatia
description: The region whose churches Paul wrote to when they were being turned to another gospel, and among whom he had first preached through infirmity of the flesh.

name: Crete
description: The island Paul's ship sailed under, and where he left Titus to set in order the things that were wanting and ordain elders in every city.

name: Melita
description: The island where Paul was cast ashore after the shipwreck, where a viper fastened on his hand and he shook it off into the fire unharmed.

name: Rome
description: The imperial city Paul was brought to as a prisoner, where he dwelt two whole years preaching the kingdom of God, and to which he wrote his great epistle.

name: Patmos
description: The isle where John was for the word of God and for the testimony of Jesus Christ, and where he was in the Spirit on the Lord's day.
